title: Microsoft Defender for Business - Simply Explained
description:
Attackers don't skip small businesses, they prefer them. That's straight from Microsoft's own threat reporting, because a small team usually has fewer people watching, and that makes it an easier target.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Defender for Business Actually Is
  • Why Antivirus Alone Isn't Enough
  • The Four Jobs It Does on Every Device
  • How You Actually Set It Up
  • The Limits You Should Know Before You Buy
  • Defender for Business vs Defender for Endpoint
  • What It Costs and How to Get It
  • The Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
